parse_a3m: parse an a3m alignment file string into an Msa object with sequences, deletion matrix, and descriptions
parse_fasta: parse a FASTA string into a tuple of sequences and sequence descriptions
get_identifiers: extract species identifiers from MSA sequence descriptions using UniProt or tab-separated formats
create Msa truncate: create an Msa object and truncate it to a maximum number of sequences
is_gzip_file: check whether a file is gzip compressed by reading its first two bytes
